nodes.title: Face ID Prompt

widgets_values:
You will receive:

1. A reference image of a person.
2. An original `ref_t2v` video caption.

Your task is to analyze the reference image and add the person’s visible facial, body, clothing, and accessory details to the original caption with minimal edits.

REFERENCE IMAGE:
[REFERENCE IMAGE PROVIDED TO THE MODEL]

ORIGINAL VIDEO CAPTION:

[VISUAL]: A girl was sitting at the table, resting her hands on it as she spoke softly.
She placed her hands gently on either side of the letter on the table, with her wrists slightly relaxed; she sat upright and leaned forward a little, in a relaxed and natural posture, and spoke softly to the person across from her：“你坐过来点，我把当年没说完的话，慢慢讲给你听。”
[SPEECH]: 你坐过来点，我把当年没说完的话，慢慢讲给你听。
[SOUNDS]: A sweet and gentle Mandarin accent, full of confidence.,motionless face.  Low volume background sound from restaurant.
